result.summary: Found 1 major issue: a broken delivery fee value displaying '€NaN' on one of the restaurant cards.

issues.description: The delivery fee under 'Smash Bros Burgers' in the 'Fastest near you' section renders as '€NaN delivery' instead of a valid numeric price.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the delivery fee value is properly parsed as a number before formatting, and provide a fallback display state (such as hiding the fee or showing 'Unavailable') when the value is null, undefined, or non-numeric.
